text.en: Hits with the weapon grant ability energy to the least charged ability.

Hits with the weapon grant ability energy to the least charged ability. Does not require Direct Hits.

Does not grant any energy to abilities that you already have a full charge of.

Ability energy gains by weapon:
• VS Pyroelectric Propellant: 0.2% //Adaptive Auto Rifle
• VS Velocity Baton: 0.365% //Area-Denial Grenade Launcher
• VS Gravitic Arrest: 0.425% //Adaptive Fusion Rifle
• VS Chill Inhibitor: 3.5% //Rapid-Fire Grenade Launcher
